title: TCI Simulator: multi-model target-controlled infusion simulator with tolerance-of-laryngoscopy isoboles
description:
Browser-based target-controlled infusion (TCI) simulator for propofol, remifentanil, fentanyl, sufentanil and alfentanil. It implements the Eleveld, Schnider, Marsh, Paedfusor, Kataria, Minto, Shafer, Scott-Stanski, Gepts and Maitre pharmacokinetic models with effect-site or plasma targeting, displays live tolerance-of-laryngoscopy isoboles (Bouillon 2004 hierarchical model and Kern 2004 Greco model) and predicted BIS, and exports the full simulation as CSV at 0.5-s resolution.

Live version: https://vonromans86.github.io/tci-simulator/

Teaching and simulation tool only. Concentrations are population predictions, not measurements; not for clinical decision-making.
